title: Expose capability qualification on iPadOS
requires: Development-signed iPadOS 26+ device with Developer Mode and native Metal
scope: Make the existing public-API conformance contracts and raw capability-qualification result available through a bounded development-only iPadOS runner, reusing shared cases and evaluators rather than converting Gallery scene checks into qualification.
acceptance: The development runner executes shared public-API trajectory, physical-quality and adverse-lifecycle inputs on the iPad Metal driver and exports raw artifacts tied to a fresh nonce and source revision.
Host collection verifies exact app/driver hashes, device model, iPadOS and Metal versions and toolchain while excluding serial numbers, pairing identifiers and other private device identifiers.
Unit and connected-device negative checks reject stale, partial, mismatched-revision and Gallery-only reports; release builds do not expose the diagnostic channel.
evidence: PASS: physical iPad13,8 Apple M1 run exported and hash-verified 35 nonce/source-bound artifacts; all 30 shared trajectories executed.
PASS: 34/34 portable CTests, 67/67 conformance tests, 7/7 deployment guards; actual-device stale/revision/binary mismatches rejected; ordinary iOS binary excludes runner markers.
